note: The Law on Credit Bureaus, article 10.1, in the Central Bank of Azerbaijan's English text: a bureau keeps collected information ten years after its last change, and a subject may not demand negative information destroyed sooner. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan, The Law of the Republic of Azerbaijan on Credit Bureaus (English)
sources.said: The credit bureau shall keep collected information for 10 years after the last change to that information and ensure that the information is provided to users.
